description.value: Little Saigon is a Vietnamese restaurant with two Abbotsford-area locations serving pho, vermicelli bowls, and rice plates made with no MSG and clean, house-made broths. The McCallum Road location is a modern dine-in spot with free parking and online ordering for quick pickup. It also operates a warehouse retail and wholesale outlet, suggesting a larger operation than a typical single-location restaurant.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 9m; rack (3 spaces) at 65m; rack at 83m; rack (3 spaces) at 93m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a Vietnamese restaurant at 160-1828 McCallum Road, Abbotsford—matching the OSM address and phone number. The site explicitly promotes pickup ordering and mentions free parking at both locations, but no bike-specific amenities (racks, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned. A significant discrepancy exists: OSM places this record in the 'Chilliwack' community, but the website and address clearly locate it in Abbotsford.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Chilliwack' but the business address and website clearly place this location in Abbotsford, BC — OSM community tag is incorrect.
OSM address field omits the unit number (160) and city; full address derived from website and OSM addr:unit tag.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active restaurant well-suited for touring cyclists as a meal stop, but none of the WWC required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. A direct venue check is needed before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: The business operates a second location in Mission (#322-32555 London Ave) and a warehouse/retail outlet in Abbotsford; the OSM record covers only the McCallum Road (Abbotsford) location.
